test_cases.name: range missing model_id
test_cases.assertion: model_id must be null; range fails to assign exact model
test_cases.details: Resolver gracefully handles range missing model_id by setting model_id to null; exact model identity blocked.

test_cases.name: invalid model_id
test_cases.assertion: invalid model_id must fail closed with MODEL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED
test_cases.details: Decoder rejects non-existent model ID and returns MODEL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.

test_cases.name: overlapping/conflicting ranges
test_cases.assertion: conflicting overlapping ranges must return null (fail closed)
test_cases.details: Resolver detects multiple matching ranges for the serial and returns null.

test_cases.name: only one chronology anchor
test_cases.assertion: single anchor cannot interpolate; must return INSUFFICIENT_ANCHORS
test_cases.details: SerialChronologyResolver enforces minimum 2 bounding anchors for interpolation.

test_cases.name: cross-plant interpolation
test_cases.assertion: anchors from different plants must be blocked with CROSS_PLANT_BLOCKED
test_cases.details: SerialChronologyResolver blocks cross-plant interpolation between plant 1 and plant 8.

test_cases.name: chronology extrapolation
test_cases.assertion: serials outside bounding anchors must be blocked with EXTRAPOLATION_BLOCKED
test_cases.details: SerialChronologyResolver rejects extrapolation outside lower and upper anchors.

test_cases.name: non-monotonic chronology
test_cases.assertion: inverted anchor years must trigger CHRONOLOGY_CONFLICT
test_cases.details: SerialChronologyResolver validates monotonicity and flags inverted anchor intervals.

test_cases.name: unknown confirmed model
test_cases.assertion: unregistered confirmed model must be rejected fail-closed
test_cases.details: Decoder returns MODEL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED when confirmed model does not match database.

test_cases.name: fuzzy user model
test_cases.assertion: non-canonical arbitrary text must not match any model
test_cases.details: Fuzzy / unparseable user string fails model lookup and rejects confirmation.

test_cases.name: USER_CONFIRMED_MODEL wrongly populates exactModel
test_cases.assertion: exactModel must be strictly null when modelIdentityStatus is USER_CONFIRMED_MODEL
test_cases.details: exactModel semantics contract enforced: user-confirmed models cannot claim exact serial proof.

test_cases.name: technical specs require eligible official evidence and pure non-hybrid context
test_cases.assertion: unanchored serials have 0 specs; MS 170 power context is 8500 rpm and strictly non-hybrid
test_cases.details: Serial-only decode has 0 specs; MS 170 power evidence has verified 8,500 rpm context without hybrid 9500 rpm corruption.

test_cases.name: fake breakpoint technical changes
test_cases.assertion: ranges provide series indication only, never unverified technical changes
test_cases.details: Range resolver strips non-standard technical fields and attaches cautionary seriesSummary.

test_cases.name: alphanumeric serial contract and genuine invalid format
test_cases.assertion: 8-10 alphanumeric serial must be FORMAT_ONLY with chronologyCompatible NO; genuine invalid lengths/chars must fail
test_cases.details: 8-10 char alphanumeric serial (12345678A) recognized as FORMAT_ONLY with chronologyCompatible NO and not counterfeit; genuine invalid formats (too short, too long, illegal chars) are rejected.

test_cases.name: unverified factory location and country
test_cases.assertion: plant code 8 must have country null, location null, details null, and confidence UNVERIFIED
test_cases.details: Plant 8 country, location, and details are strictly null; confidence is UNVERIFIED; zero geographic inference.

test_cases.name: userProvidedYear promoted to exact official year
test_cases.assertion: userProvidedYear must stay isolated and never promote production.status to EXACT_DOCUMENTED_YEAR
test_cases.details: userProvidedYear is stored as USER_PROVIDED_YEAR while production.status remains UNKNOWN.
